trigger: Intro card (Y3): entering the Elder Kappa elder node
text: The Elder Kappa bows, slow and correct, and not a drop spills from its dish. "Once I have taken hold, honoured guest, there is no breaking free. Please do not be taken."
speaker: Elder Kappa
notes: Voice for Oni/Kappa is a proposal (vault Characters open question): Oni proud and blunt, Kappa formal and polite.
